inputs.dependencyLayout: Baseline and candidate resolve dependencies through the same physical repository node_modules. No dependencies were added or replaced.

decisions.change: Conditional awaits in createAndProcessResource and SVG processing; Promise return contract retained.
Direct synchronous hook loop; allocate continuation only for an asynchronous result.
Six captures instead of twelve; return capture index without a temporary object.

decisions.reason: Combined CSS bookkeeping collections gave negligible sampled allocation change, approximately 1% in the exploratory profiles.

allocation.metric: Sum of selfSize across the inspector sampling profile tree; sampled cumulative allocation, not exact bytes, retained heap, peak heap or RSS.

protocol.pressure: JavaScript arrays of 32768 elements (256 KiB), retaining up to eight; released before post-GC retention checks.
protocol.scope: Real pipeline and AsyncLocalStorage crawl context, real Cheerio/URIjs; profiling separate from timing.
protocol.confidence: Three triplets; descriptive paired medians, no formal confidence claim.

allocation.verification: All 90 final heap-profile tree totals, paired percentages and output hashes independently recomputed.

timing.conclusion: No case passed the full timing rule. Sufficient-round cases failed identical-code controls; other cases lacked qualifying rounds. No confirmed speedup, slowdown or strict non-regression.
timing.host: Windows background load varied during the session; WSL load average was not a reliable idle indicator. Analysis and profiling continued without waiting for idle. Individual workload probes and failed controls are preserved below.
timing.pooling: None; normal/pressure and fresh-process/interleaved campaigns are separate.

retention.protocol: Ten repeated mixed batches in separate baseline/candidate/identical-candidate processes per mode; GC between cases, pressure arrays released before retained-heap measurement.
retention.conclusion: No sustained post-GC heap growth observed. All versions settle around 13.3 MiB normally and 12.0 MiB under pressure. RSS varies by several MiB between identical runs; no RSS reduction established.
retention.peakLimit: heapPeakObserved is sampled at workload boundaries, not an exact instantaneous peak. Some SVG diagnostics were higher; no peak-memory reduction established.
